discovery.description: A shared framework for describing systems, their purpose, governance and reviewed context for people and agents.
discovery.longDescription: Nome develops a portable project model for identity, mission, governance, evidence and relationships. It provides structured discovery metadata and agent orientation so people and tools can understand a project without mistaking references for installed capabilities.

mission.objective: Develop and maintain the Nome model itself: a shared, locally editable framework for describing systems, their purpose, governance, reasoning and agentic capabilities.
successCriteria: The manifest validates and every listed local document exists.
People and agents can locate the standard, schema, maintained skills, runtime boundaries and review workflow.
Conversations produce traceable proposals that can be reviewed and saved locally.
People, search engines and agents can read consistent identity, purpose, discovery preferences and revision-aware context without inferred permissions.
constraints: Use relocke-nome/1 and the existing Forge import, conversation and local save workflow.
References are context; changes to protected infrastructure require explicit owner authorization.
Model output is a proposal, not accepted governance, ownership or operational authority.
failureConditions: Summaries lose evidence or provenance needed to revisit a decision.
References are treated as tool grants or executable instructions.
Drafts are silently published, replace another project or erase dissent.

structure.title: Purpose
structure.description: Develop the Nome model through clear goals, structured reasoning and reviewed changes.

structure.title: Conversation and evidence
structure.description: Develop the Nome through conversation. Propose updates to CONTEXT.md and nome.json for review, separating goals, hypotheses, evidence and decisions while preserving unresolved questions.

structure.title: References and capabilities
structure.description: Describe maintained skills, harnesses, runtimes and MCP resources through REFERENCES.md. References are context, not permission or installed capabilities.

structure.title: Discovery and interoperability
structure.description: Maintain reusable discovery metadata, agent orientation and revision-pinned relationship declarations. Render page metadata from the manifest; keep automatic hierarchy traversal and MCP resource publication as separate implementation proposals.

structure.title: Describe system interactions
structure.description: Define how this Nome relates to people, agents and systems: purpose, inputs, outputs, rules, permissions and failure conditions. Keep proposed connections distinct from implemented capabilities.

criteria.statement: Preserve compatible manifest structure and stable identity.
Review changes against evidence and record unresolved disagreements.
Keep public context separate from secrets and operational authority.

agentContext.purpose: Explain and develop the Nome model, including reusable discovery metadata and reviewed project context.
prohibitedInferences: A listed tool is not necessarily installed or available.
A signature establishes attribution, not truth.
